summary: Forafric Global PLC announced completion of a transaction transferring a 68% controlling interest in Forafric Maroc S.A. from its wholly owned subsidiary Forafric Agro Industries to Cap Holding SA, a Moroccan industrial group. Consideration includes a MAD 100 million (US$10 million) capital increase, a ~MAD 280 million (US$28 million) debt reduction, and two-year funding support. Crédit Agricole du Maroc will convert MAD 100 million debt into a 7% stake, pending close. The divestiture supports Forafric Global's strategic focus on Defense, Energy, and Food Security. Watch for closing of the Crédit Agricole conversion and potential Millcorp acquisition.
